name: Dominican Republic

fees.name: Tourist visa (single entry, consular)
fees.notes: MIREX consular fee as published on the official VFS Global Dominican Republic page (India). Multiple-entry tourist visa is USD 150. Paid at the visa application centre (in India ~INR 8,400 single / 12,600 multiple).

fees.name: Tourist card (entry tax, Law 199-67)
fees.applies: visa-exempt visitors; included in airfare for arrivals by air, paid on arrival for land/sea entries
fees.notes: Since 2018 the USD 10 tourist card fee is bundled into airline tickets issued outside the DR; travellers arriving by land or sea pay USD 10 at entry.

fees.name: E-Ticket (electronic entry/exit form)
fees.notes: Mandatory digital migration/customs/health form via the official DGM portal; free of charge. Not a visa or travel authorisation.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: MIREX lists transit as a visa category but no current fee could be verified on an official source; amount left null.

vfs.note: VFS logistic fee in India: INR 500 for tourist category, INR 1,000 for other categories (Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru). Fees vary by country/centre; non-refundable.

free_visa_notes: Most visitors (USA, Canada, UK, EU, Russia, Japan, Israel, Mexico, most of the Americas, etc.) do not need a visa; they enter under the USD 10 tourist card (included in airfare for air arrivals) plus the free e-Ticket. No reciprocity-based fee differences found; MIREX consular fees appear uniform by visa category rather than nationality.
